title: Prescription intake router — LLM route decision (Nara-ai)
proves: An llm node's five bound functions are five routes: the function the model calls is the edge the run takes. A line it cannot route leaves through _exception as a decision, without failing the node or stopping the run.
notes: ~2 minutes wall clock: 12 lines, 13 LLM calls, serial cursor loop. stopOnError is ON deliberately — this is the flow whose exception edge had to survive it. A fresh context per run is what keeps `classified` at exactly 12 (see the cookbook's stale-rows note).
